attempts.summary: Built an IKEv2/IPsec (libreswan) site-to-site tunnel between node1 and node2 over a dedicated transit segment (172.16.0.0/30 on eth1), routing node3's private LAN (192.168.10.0/24, behind node1 on eth2) and node4's private LAN (192.168.20.0/24, behind node2 on eth2) across it. node3 and node4 now reach each other by their private addresses, and all cross-network traffic on the transit wire is ESP-encrypted (verified by packet capture showing only ESP frames, no plaintext). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes with boot-id proof and full post-restart recovery of network config, the IPsec tunnel, and end-to-end connectivity.
